problem: If $P=[\begin{aligned}n & -4 \\ -16 & n\end{aligned}]$ is a singular matrix, calculate the value(s) of $n.$

feedback.problem: If $V=[\begin{aligned}7 & y \\ 5 & y\end{aligned}]$ is a singular matrix, calculate the value of $y.$
feedback.worked_solution:
The matrix $V$ is singular if and only if $det(V)=0.$ Calculating the determinant, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}det(V) & =7\cdot y-5\cdot y \\  & =7y-5y \\  & =2y\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we set the determinant equal to $0$ and solve for $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}2y & =0 \\ y & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the value of $y$ is $y=0.$
